beats.text: Three bedroom facts worth saving. All backed by research!
One: once a week is enough. In data from over thirty thousand people, well-being rose with sex up to once a week. More didn't help.
Two: don't skip the cuddle. Couples who spent more time on affection after sex felt more satisfied. And fact three?
The afterglow lasts about two days!
So: once a week. Cuddle after. Enjoy the glow!

sources: Muise, Schimmack & Impett (2016), Sexual frequency predicts greater well-being, but more is not always better, Social Psychological and Personality Science 7(4) – 30,000+ Americans; no further gain beyond once a week.
Muise, Giang & Impett (2014), Post sex affectionate exchanges promote sexual and relationship satisfaction, Archives of Sexual Behavior 43(7).
Meltzer et al. (2017), Quantifying the sexual afterglow, Psychological Science 28(5) – sexual satisfaction stays elevated ~48 hours after sex.
